te.text.CHESTSEAL.1: Name chest seals in an anvil, then apply seals of the same colour and name to empty single chests to share their inventory. A chest seal of any colour can also copy a bound chest's network and colour by clicking it. Networks span dimensions; automation operates only at loaded endpoints. Breaking any bound chest drops the shared contents, so take care.
te.text.ROD_BREAD.1: An optional French bread wand easter egg. Enable breadWand in the mod configuration to research and craft it. It stores 39 vis of each primal aspect and occasionally speaks.
